To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we designed a reactive polymer with temperature-sensitive property and succeeded with the preparation by copolymerization of IPAAm and 2-carboxisopropylamid.
we have succeeded in the preparation of a novel bifunctional polymer, which possesses reactive functional groups and a temperature-sensitive response.

the copolymerization of IPAAm and 2-carboxisopropylamidine (CIPAA) resulted in the formation of a novel polymer, poly(IPAAmco-CIPAAm), which has temperature-sensitive properties and carboxyl groups as reactive functional groups.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, preparation and characterization of a novel polymer with reactivity, temperature-sensitivity, and biocompatibility.
the synthesis of novel bifunctional polymers, which have temperature-sensitive properties and reactive groups.
the synthesis of novel bifunctional polymer, poly(IPAAmco-CIPAAm)s.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the IPAAm-co- CIPAAm random polymer has a homopolymer-like polymer backbone and is a useful bifunctionally reactive polymer.
the poly(IPAAmA-co-CIPAAmA) random copolymer was a useful bifunctionaL polymer with reactivity (or bioconjugation ability) and temperature sensitivity.
the poly(IPAAmA-co-CIPAAmA)s are useful bifunctional polymers with temperature-sensitivity and reactive functional groups.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the copolymerization between the reactive monomer, CIPAAm, and the temperature-sensitive IPAAm monomer would be the best choice to design a bifunctional polymer for the application in drug release and other fields.
the polymer backbone of the polymer is a key factor in maintaining temperature sensitivity of the polymer chain.
the IPAAm-co-AAAc copolymer was not a good candidate for the bifunctional polymer, and that the IPAAAm-co-CIPAAAm copolymer was a good candidate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the homopolymeric structure in the polymer chains is essential for temperature-sensitive polymers to exhibit sensitive response.
the IPAAm-co- CIPAAm random structure is very useful to obtain the temperature-responsive copolymer with a narrow temperature range of phase transition.
the IPAAm homopolymers with reactive functional group are useful for the preparation of bifuncational polymer.
